title: A certified two-point equilibrium range for the reciprocal-xi contest
summary: We give an unconditional equilibrium characterization for Ewerhart’s reciprocal-xi contest on an explicit prize interval. Let f be the normalized inverse Fourier transform of ξ(1/2)/ξ(1/2+u) and let G(y) = ∫₀ʸ f(t) dt. The unique equilibrium is zero effort for 0 0.94817826. Uniqueness holds among all Borel mixed strategies, including asymmetric profiles. The proof reduces uniqueness to a strict payoff inequality, establishes that inequality analytically for small y, and extends it to Y by a uniform finite certificate.
